lines.text: CHATTER! Your teeth knock together and your shoulders shake like a dance machine!
Why does your body vibrate uncontrollably when you step into the cold?
Your brain has a built-in thermostat called the hypothalamus!
It keeps your internal body temperature at a cozy ninety-eight point six degrees!
If cold wind drops your skin temperature even by one little degree...
Emergency alarms trigger! Your brain orders your skeletal muscles to twitch!
Muscles contract and relax up to thirty times every single second!
This rapid muscle workout generates instant heat to protect your vital organs!
Your body's automatic defenses are genius—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
